newsitem.title: USA: Monroc explores alternatives including sale.
newsitem.headline: Monroc explores alternatives including sale.

text.p: Monroc Inc said Tuesday it hired Dillon, Read & Co to help the company explore various strategic alternatives including a sale.
The company said the alternatives include a sale of all or part of the company, strategic alliances or a merger with a suitable partner.

Ronald Davis, president and chief executive officer, said that any such transaction contemplated by the company would be subject to satisfactory negotiations regarding valuation of Monroc and other terms, as well as board approval.
"Monroc is committed to pursuing opportunities that will maximize long-term value for its shareholders and enhance the company's operational strengths and capabilities," said Davis.
